# `notification_consent`

Area: **notifications** ([all tables](README.md))

Append-only history of a customer's marketing consent per channel (opt-in or opt-out, with its source): the latest row wins and no row means not opted in. Transactional messages need no consent.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `seq` | `bigint` | no |  | Insertion order: the tie-break when two rows share a recorded_at. |
| `customer_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `channel` | `text` | no |  |  |
| `category` | `text` | no |  |  |
| `opted_in` | `boolean` | no |  |  |
| `source` | `text` | no |  | How the consent was obtained (for example signup, sms keyword, call). |
| `recorded_by` | `text` | no |  | The operator who recorded it. |
| `recorded_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
